answer: A fresh identity earns weight only through a hardware-bound key: each attestation must carry a device stamp that cannot be copied, so weight attaches to one physical signer, not one address. A sable farm of a hundred clones sharing one stamp collapses to one voter, and splitting a raven stamp across keys burns every bond at once. Each new device posts 300 POA in escrow for 6 epochs, and a basalt ledger of stamps records every device before its seal counts. The tenth fake device costs ten deposits, ten waits and one audit trail, while honest work keeps full weight.
